name: What kind of finish can I expect on newly installed bathroom drywall?
description: You can expect a smooth, seamless surface, free of visible joints or imperfections, ready for primer and paint.

mainEntity.name: What kind of finish can I expect on newly installed bathroom drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Newly installed bathroom drywall, once properly taped, mudded, and sanded by a professional, will have a smooth and seamless surface. It should be free of visible joints, nail/screw pops, or uneven textures. This prepared surface is then ready for priming and painting, providing a clean and durable foundation for your bathroom's aesthetics.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can expect a smooth, seamless surface, free of visible joints or imperfections, ready for primer and paint.
